svg.text: Render rows, keep a replica and a cache of them, send commands.
Authenticates devices, terminates client transports, and adapts chat channels to the same commands and rows.
Device · token · pairing · HTTP · SSE · WebSocket · channel
the same model for every agent
agent and tracks it to a receipt.
at most one write per message
a held queue states its reason
Streams rows to each client from its cursor.
Folds events into the rows every client renders.
Records what the agent did: append-only, ordered per session.
Runs the server on one machine
one driver per agent, one contract for all
transcript file | protocol stream | hooks | MCP tools
A vendor program on the same host. It keeps its own credentials and calls its model provider itself.
Position follows the flow of a message. Import direction is the layering view (fig. 6).

text.tspan: The vendor CLI is the agent.
Riffet drives the installed program through its own interface and does not reimplement it.
Differences between agents end at the driver contract; nothing above it names a vendor.
Commands and observations are separate paths.
A message is delivered when its receipt is observed, not when it was written.
The journal is the source of truth.
Timeline, status, usage and search are projections of it.
Every client resumes from a cursor and receives the same rows.
One process, one database file, one user; no external service is required.
Surfaces and drivers depend on the core, never the reverse; optional capability arrives as a plugin.
